translations.en: Milfe, a port... remote, rich in marine and mining,
Also thrives as trade hub, independent city.
I arrived at this town, our journey's destination,
I stopped as I entered the central plaza.
Our ship to this town ran aground,
Walking overland, my body felt at the destination
a pleasant fatigue from the relief of arrival.
I rarely tire, so this new sensation felt good.
Feeling odd, I opened my collar and peeked.
I am a man, but there, though faint, is
a bulge that a man should not have.
(I had forgotten...
I should not overdo it...)
I chide myself of this bodily change from fatigue.
We finally arrived, Master.
At that, I closed my shirt, looked up, turned.
A girl with a large pack looks up at me.
Her name is Shuri. For various reasons,
she is my live-in servant, along for this journey.
She was orphaned by war; I took her in.
Since then, she has worked as a servant at home,
mainly taking care of my personal needs.
Having worked here since childhood among servants,
she is especially obedient, devoted, and capable,
Lately, she has become more calm with age,
she keeps her distance now, which makes me lonely.
Is something wrong, Master?
No, it's nothing...
Shuri is staring at me.
That anxious look is the same as when I found her
on the battlefield a decade ago, it hasn't changed.
